Consider the picture shown above. Find a unit vector that is parallel to $\mathbf a.$
question.worked_solution:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14251721/assets/b316448c885a20a7ed60871ce0f1a4dc4f77bd4658dc6eda3407fb3c89a088cb.png)

In $\bigtriangleup AHB$ we have $\angle AHB = 90^\circ$, $AH=3$ and $BH=2$. So, the Pythagorean theorem gives

$$
\begin{aligned}AB & =\sqrt{A{H}^{2}+B{H}^{2}} \\  & =\sqrt{{3}^{2}+{2}^{2}} \\  & =\sqrt{9+4} \\  & =\sqrt{13}.\end{aligned}
$$

Hence, the magnitude of $\mathbf{a}$ is $\sqrt{13}$. Consequently, the unit vector is

$$
\begin{aligned}u & =\frac{1}{|\,a\,|}\cdot a \\  & =\frac{1}{\sqrt{13}}a\end{aligned}
$$
